name: magic-ui-marquee

frames.best_why: Both rows are fully populated with three complete review cards visible and clearly spaced.

tagline: Two rows of review cards scroll past in opposite directions.
summary: A horizontal ticker of testimonial cards, duplicated enough times to loop seamlessly; the two demo rows glide opposite ways and freeze when hovered.
appearance: Two stacked rows of small dark review cards with rounded corners and thin borders, each holding a round avatar, a name, a handle and a short quote. The rows run edge to edge on black and fade out at the sides.
behaviour: Each row slides sideways on a loop, the two rows moving in opposite directions. Hovering a row freezes it until the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Six fake testimonials from names like Maya Patel and Aiko Tanaka praising a UI kit.
use_when: A wall of social proof should keep moving to show volume without taking more height.
avoid_when: Fewer than about six items: the loop repeats the same cards visibly.
customise: Direction, vertical mode, repeat count, pause-on-hover and duration are props or CSS variables; the card content is whatever you pass as children.
weight_why: A handful of duplicated card siblings moved by one CSS transform keyframe.

a11y.note: Pauses on hover only, so keyboard users cannot stop the motion, and it keeps moving with no reduced-motion guard.

polish_why: Clean card rows and a seamless loop; the cards are small and the quote text is tiny.
